summary: Frontend-only test of the UI redesign + light/dark theme toggle. All requested flows PASS: theme-toggle present on Landing nav, Login, Signup, Dashboard sidebar (desktop bottom) and mobile top bar; default (empty localStorage) = dark; toggling flips <html>.dark and writes rf_theme light/dark; persists across reload and Landing->Login->Signup->Dashboard navigation. Both themes visually checked at 1920x800 and 390x844 on /, /login, /signup, /dashboard (inbox + open conversation + AI summary + quick replies + composer), products (+Add product dialog), orders, settings (business, FAQs, Notion, Bakong payments, team access, quick replies, voice/khmer-voice-card/seller voice, AI behaviour), channels, businesses: no unreadable text or invisible inputs/borders found; no horizontal overflow on mobile; mobile admin top bar (logo + 6 nav icons + theme toggle + logout) fits within 390px (logout right edge 382px). Landing testids all render, links -> /signup, /login, #how correct. Login admin works -> /dashboard, wrong password shows login-error 'Invalid email or password'; google-login-btn and signup-google-btn present; go-signup-link/go-login-link navigate. Nav active state (bg-primary/10 text-primary) ok; logout clears rf_token -> /login. Settings save: assistant-name-input set to TEST_Bot, saved, reload kept, restored to '' and verified. Filter chips switch (admin: all=2, telegram=2, messenger=0). Primary buttons use btn-brand gradient; green kept for AI auto-reply/success. No page JS errors.

issues: Native <audio> controls render as light/white pills on dark bubbles and cards (browser default). Cosmetic; could add `color-scheme: dark` on .dark root so native controls follow theme.
Light mode shows an amber-tinted card; in dark it is almost indistinguishable from the surrounding card (very faint tint). Cosmetic only.
Still hardcoded bg-white (product photo/KHQR card) - stays white in dark mode; likely intentional for QR readability, just confirm.

action_items: Optional: add `.dark { color-scheme: dark; }` in index.css so native audio/select/scrollbar controls match dark theme
Optional: slightly stronger amber tint for khmer-voice-card in dark mode
critical_code_review_comments: theme.js toggles the class inside a setState updater (side effect in updater; under StrictMode double-invocation could toggle twice in dev). Safer: compute next, then set class/localStorage in a useEffect on [theme]. Not reproduced as a bug in preview.
Remaining hardcoded colours are intentional (text-white on bg-brand, red destructive buttons, brand hexes for Telegram/Messenger icons, slate-500 neutral status chips).
